name: Screen Time
author: ricky
description: Daily screen time tracking with a GitHub-style contribution heatmap. Digital Wellbeing for your Omarchy bar, fully local.

barWidget.description: Today's screen time in the bar, with a year heatmap of daily usage boxes and a per-app breakdown.

schema.label: Daily limit (hours)
schema.description: Heatmap intensity and the over-limit colour are scaled against this.

schema.label: Months of history in the heatmap
schema.description: How many months of daily boxes the panel shows at once. Six fits comfortably; more makes the boxes smaller.

schema.label: Count as idle after (seconds)
schema.description: Time stops accruing once there has been no input for this long.

schema.label: Bar display
schema.description: strip = boxes + total, total = time only, icon = glyph only.

schema.label: Heatmap palette
schema.description: accent = theme accent like GitHub, traffic = green under limit through red over it.

schema.label: Track data usage per app
schema.description: Samples the TCP socket table so the breakdown shows how much each app downloaded (D) and uploaded (U). Reads only your own sockets; QUIC/HTTP3 traffic is not visible to it and undercounts.

schema.label: What to record inside a window
schema.description: off = app names only. terminal = also the program or directory in terminals. full = also which site a browser is on (taken from the tab title, never the page you were reading).

schema.label: Also ignore these apps
schema.description: Comma-separated app ids that should never count. Screensaver and lock screens are always ignored. Trailing * matches a prefix, e.g. steam_app_*

schema.label: Keep per-app detail for (days)
schema.description: Daily totals are kept forever; per-app detail older than this is dropped.
